edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before setting a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to finalize ownership.
transfer debits and credits balances indexed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowance for msg.sender and passes it to the callback.
Any caller sending ETH hits the fallback which reverts.
owner is read by the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
owner is overwritten when the pending owner accepts ownership.
onlyOwner protection and owner is the recipient of the rescued tokens.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner as the authorization source.
acceptOwnership copies newOwner into the owner state variable.
Two-step ownership handoff: transferOwnership must precede acceptOwnership.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes into the allowed mapping before the external call.
Constructor sets _totalSupply and credits balances.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
Deployment initializes balances which later feed the transfer/approval paths.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit msg.sender.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom calls safeSub on both the balance and the allowance.
safeAdd performs unsigned addition whose overflow guard is the only protection.
safeSub performs unsigned subtraction relying on require(b <= a).
transfer relies entirely on SafeMath for balance arithmetic.
transferFrom relies entirely on SafeMath for balance and allowance arithmetic.
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender, tokens and attacker-supplied data to the spender contract.
Attacker-controlled bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
receiveApproval executes in the spender contract and can re-enter approveAndCall or transferFrom.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token address.
The external ERC20 transfer call returns control to the rescue function.
tokenAddress is used as the target of the external call.
All value-bearing calls are rejected by the reverting fallback.
